# Build and lint tools for bayan-desktop, installed with `pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all:` by scripts/dev-setup.sh (locally, in cloud sessions and in CI).
# Every version is pinned exactly and was at least 24 hours old when pinned (ADR-0017). Publish dates on PyPI:
#   cmake 4.4.4 (2026-10-04), ninja 1.13.2 (2026-08-30),
#   clang-format 23.1.4 (2026-11-04), clang-tidy 23.1.4 (2026-10-26; the newest clang-tidy, so clang-format is kept on the same LLVM release rather than on its 23.1.5 of 2026-11-04).
# Update only in the monthly dependency session. Regenerate the hashes (all platforms, any CPython 3.11 or newer) with uv, using a cutoff at least 24 hours in the past:
#   printf 'cmake==4.4.4\nninja==1.13.2\nclang-format==23.1.4\nclang-tidy==23.1.4\n' | uv pip compile -q --universal --python-version 3.11 --only-binary :all: --generate-hashes --exclude-newer 2026-11-13T09:36:00Z --no-header --no-annotate - -o deps/requirements-tools.txt
# then put this comment block back at the top.
